ValidationRule.description: Prevents users from updating Legal Journey Stage on Collections cases unless Collections Current Debt is populated and greater than 0; bypassed for users with SC_BypassValidationRules.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.SC_BypassValidationRules), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Collections", ISCHANGED(SC_LegalJourneyStage__c), NOT(ISPICKVAL(SC_LegalJourneyStage__c, "")), OR( ISBLANK(SC_CollectionsCurrentDebt__c), SC_CollectionsCurrentDebt__c <= 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Legal Journey Stage can only be updated when Collections Current Debt is greater than 0.
